author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Reads as a car tilted on a slope, wheels resting on the incline, at 48 in both themes; all nodes on a 3-4-5 slope frame.
omissions: The ramp is a single slope line instead of a filled triangle: a triangle base would run 2 units under the rear wheel. The slope is 37 degrees (3-4-5) rather than the reference's gentler angle, so the wheel contacts land on grid points.
